answer: Pay a bonus only to dissenters who turn out right. Each task's verdicts are sealed; later a beacon-picked audit settles the truth, and a fixed pot goes to seats that disagreed with the majority yet matched the audit, split per head. A clone farm gains nothing by piling in: like marbles dropped into one cup, each copy thins its own share and soon turns the view into the majority, killing the bonus. Independent seats earn by thinking alone, like a river cutting its own channel to the right vertex of a hard question.
